messages:
sophia: Deploy bot kicked off progressive rollout for rwinf-api v2.3.1 -> 10% eu-west at 21:00PT. tagging ops and eng-releases. https://dash/redwood/deploy/2167890123

deploy-bot: automated check: smoke tests OK, canary logs streaming -> https://logs/redwood/canary/2167890123 :white_check_mark:

mike: seeing a small 99p latency bump in eu-west canary (from 210ms -> ~320ms) starting ~21:07PT. not sure if noise.
alice: can you paste the sample traces? check kv cache hit rate and any missing kernels.
mike: trace snippets: `kernel_select: fallback_quantized_v2` and a couple GC pauses. kv_hits = 78% (down from 92%).
ben: hmm, kv hit drop suggests cache warming issue. was there any config change to `prefetch` or `cache_size` in this release?
ciara: release diff had kernel-selection tweak + lowered default cache_size by 20% to reduce mem pressure. that might explain it.
ops-oncall: we also got an alert for ephemeral OOMs on a single box in eu-west-3 at 21:08PT, pod restarted, no user-facing 5xx yet. linking incident: https://inc/redwood/INC-4832
sophia: @channel quick decision: continue to 30% or pause and pin? my read: single-host OOM + latency bump + cache hit drop -> hold. proposal: pause rollout, pin eu-west traffic to v2.3.0, and run a hotfix (increase cache_size + revert kernel tweak) in a patch.
ben: +1 to pause and pin. want to avoid cascading warmup penalties across more pods.
mike: support pause. I've collected heap dumps and logs, will attach to the incident.
ciara: I can draft the quick roll-forward patch branch now: revert kernel selector change and bump cache_size to previous value. estimate ~45m to build + smoke.
sophia: okay. @deploy-bot please execute: pause rollout for rwinf-api v2.3.1 in eu-west and pin region to v2.3.0. mention in release notes that eu-west experienced a conservative pause due to cache warming regressions.
deploy-bot: action: rollback/pin initiated -> traffic for eu-west pinned to rwinf-api v2.3.0, rollout paused globally. rollback window set for 60m. Audit id: AUD-2167890123.
ops-oncall: verifying pinned traffic now. no additional OOMs after pin.
ciara: starting hotfix build. will post an ETA.
sophia: I'll update release notes and send a short customer-facing blurb for change window (scheduled 22:30PT patch). keep this thread for final GO/NO-GO.
ben: archive checklist: rollback reason, metrics snapshot, hotfix PR link, customer note.
ciara: hotfix PR: https://git/redwood/rwinf/compare/v2.3.1-hotfix-cache-revert. smoke queueing.
mike: after pin, latency back to baseline in eu-west within 2 minutes. good signal.
sophia: thank you. will reconvene at 22:05PT for a GO/NO-GO to resume progressive rollout to 30% after hotfix verification. :eye:
